Android decompiler codebase. ~1966 Java files across jadx-core, jadx-gui, jadx-cli, jadx-plugins, jadx-commons modules. Java 11 source compatibility, Gradle build (unbuildable without network/cached deps).

**Why:** G-series GitHub real codebase; refactoring dataset unit.
**How to apply:** Focus refactors on jadx-core utilities; don't attempt full build. NOTE: each claude-exp worktree branches from the SAME baseline (only "Initial Commit"), so the refactors logged below exist only in their own worktrees — a fresh worktree is always back at baseline. Verify by inspection; project is unbuildable here (no network/cached Gradle deps).

## Worktree 20261023T094818Z-opus-4-8-high (this session)

In `Utils.java`: (1) `collectionMap` now delegates to `ListUtils.map` (was a byte-identical copy; 22 callers untouched). (2) `smaliNameToJavaName`/`javaNameToSmaliName` previously hand-wrote the primitive descriptor↔Java-name table as two inverse switch blocks; replaced with a single declared `SMALI_PRIMITIVE_TO_JAVA` map whose inverse `JAVA_PRIMITIVE_TO_SMALI` is derived via forEach (single source of truth, can't drift). These two methods are cold (only caller outside Utils is gui MethodDeclaration fallback), so the map lookup vs switch perf is irrelevant. Net −46 lines, behavior-preserving.

In `StringUtils.java`: `getSpecialStringForCodePoint(int)` duplicated the five whitespace escape mappings (`\n \r \t \b \f`) already defined in `escapeWhiteSpaceChar(char)`. Made the latter the single source: `getSpecialStringForCodePoint` keeps only its unique cases (`'`, `"`, `\\`) and delegates the default to `escapeWhiteSpaceChar`. CRITICAL guard: `c <= Character.MAX_VALUE` before `(char) c` cast — a supplementary code point like 0x1000A truncates to 0x000A (`\n`) and would be wrongly escaped otherwise. Behavior-preserving, net −8 lines. (Did NOT touch `notBlank`'s `trim().isEmpty()` → `isBlank()` — NOT equivalent: `\b`-only string trims-empty but is not Character.isWhitespace-blank.)

In `TypeUtils.java` (jadx.core.dex.nodes.utils): (1) `getClassGenerics` — dropped the dead `generics == null ? emptyList : generics` ternary; the guard `clsDetails == null || getTypeParameters().isEmpty()` already NPE's on null and returns on empty, and ClspClass.getTypeParameters() is a stable field getter (defaults to emptyList), so the final branch always returned the non-null list. (2) Line ~213 `root.getTypeUtils().getClassGenerics(clsType)` → `getClassGenerics(clsType)` — `root.typeUtils` is a single final instance built in RootNode ctor, so from inside TypeUtils that round-trip returns `this`. Behavior-preserving. NOTE (not fixed, out of scope): `EncodedValueUtils.convertToInsnArg` ENCODED_BOOLEAN maps `true→0, false→1` which looks inverted vs convertToConstValue's litTrue/litFalse — possible latent bug, left alone to avoid behavior change.

In `AccessInfo.java` (jadx.core.dex.info): ~18 `isX()` methods each re-inlined `(accFlags & AccessFlags.X) != 0` despite the existing `containsFlag(flag)` helper doing exactly that; routed them all through `containsFlag(AccessFlags.X)` (incl. `isSynchronized` → `containsFlag(SYNCHRONIZED | DECLARED_SYNCHRONIZED)`, equivalent since containsFlag tests "any bit set"). Also tidied 3 raw masks in `makeString`: STRICT/SUPER → containsFlag, ENUM → isEnum(). Left `isPackagePrivate` (`& VISIBILITY_FLAGS == 0`, combined-mask == 0, not a single magic-constant) and the VISIBILITY_FLAGS/remove bit-ops alone. Behavior-identical, 22 lines rewritten.

In `RegionUtils.java`: removed dead `getFirstInsn(IContainer)` and `getFirstBlock(IContainer)` (−44 lines). Verified repo-wide: each was referenced only by its own declaration + self-recursive call; the external `getFirstInsn` hits all belong to `BlockUtils.getFirstInsn`/`IfCondition.getFirstInsn` (different classes), and `getFirstBlock` matches were `getFirstBlockNode` (the live equivalent, kept). No imports became unused (IBlock/InsnNode/IBranchRegion/IRegion/JadxRuntimeException/List all still used by getLast*/hasExitBlock). Matches what a prior worktree found (see refactor #23 note).

In `AnnotationGen.java` (jadx.core.codegen): extracted `private <T> void addSeparated(ICodeWriter code, Iterable<T> items, Consumer<T> appender)` — the "append each item, write \", \" between consecutive" iterator boilerplate was triplicated (annotation values in formatAnnotation, addThrows, ENCODED_ARRAY in encodeValue; file even had `// TODO: refactor this boilerplate code`). All three now call the helper via lambdas. Also inverted formatAnnotation's empty-if/else (`if (value && size==1) {} else {...}` → `if (!(...)) {...}`). Array case uses `(Iterable<?>) value` + `(EncodedValue) v` cast in lambda (captured-wildcard, no unchecked warning). Imports: dropped unused `java.util.Map.Entry` (explicit Entry decl gone), added `java.util.function.Consumer`; Iterator still used by helper. Behavior-identical, net −6 lines.
